We offer a 30-day Happiness Guarantee! You can return or exchange your item(s) for any reason within 30 days of delivery, as long as they are in new and sellable condition. This means the items should not have any visible damage, stains, or pet hair.

We've got you covered on shipping: Tumble provides free returns and exchanges for our customers in the contiguous US and Canada. ⭐️

Just a few things to keep in mind:

Items can only be exchanged once (we don't accept an exchange of an exchange).
Rug swatches are final sale and cannot be returned or exchanged.

If you're ready to get started, you can initiate your request at our Returns/Exchange Center:

For US: https://www.tumbleliving.com/pages/returns-and-exchanges
For Canada: http://tumbleliving.ca/pages/returns-and-exchanges

You'll just need your order number and the email address used at checkout. Once you submit the form, you'll receive a prepaid FedEx label via email. You can print it out or simply use the QR code at a FedEx drop-off location.

Thank you for being with us as a customer. Feel free to reach out for with any other questions.
